$comment: Deploy this repository as a static Vercel project with the Root Directory left at the repo root. The build assembles public/: landing page at /, PWA at /app/.
$comment2: trailingSlash makes Vercel redirect /app to /app/. Without it the PWA is served at /app and every relative asset URL resolves against the site root instead of the app directory, so the whole app 404s.
